newsitem.title: FINLAND: LAROX WINS FIM 20 MLN OUTOKUMPU ORDER.
newsitem.headline: LAROX WINS FIM 20 MLN OUTOKUMPU ORDER.

text.p: Finnish industrial filters and valve maker Larox Oy said in a statement on Monday it won an almost 20 million markka order from Outokumpu Oy.

"Larox has won a significant order from Outokumpu Zinc to expand its zinc factory," Larox said. "The order is worth alomost 20 millon markka and the deal includes options worth seven million markka," it said.
"The order strengthens Larox's significant position as a supplier of filters for zinc factories and Outokumpu Zinc's position as leading developer of zinc processes," Larox said.
Larox has delivered over 50 pressure filters around the world for the processing of zinc, it added.
